notes.title: SCP Foundation: ITTLG - Chapter 2 (12.XX.2021)
notes.content:
Like a said before this is my first game. 
And I guess if someone select the "Credits" section in the Main Menu.
Will find out that the characters are actually not my work. 
And if this chapter and chapter 2 are about to fail. I'll stop with chapter 2.

After all I am only 18yo. And I guess you know guys it's not free to make a game.

And I will be able to make chapter 3 only if we get:

* 500 sold copies for Chapter 1 ( 30 copies sold <3 )
* or 500 sold copies for Chapter 2

One of the chapters needs to reach that much copies which are sold.
This is part of the last character, my artist made for the game.
And it'll be sad if he can't get his role in chapter 3

+ the hot chick doctor which you can find in the description in the store page for chapter 1
